velocity_frame.note: Reference frame of the velocity data

device_id.note: unique device ID for the sensor that does not change between power cycles

distance_m.note: (meters) Distance to the center of the flow field (NAN if unavailable)

max_flow_rate.note: (radians/s) Magnitude of maximum angular which the optical flow sensor can measure reliably

max_ground_distance.note: (meters) Maximum distance from ground at which the optical flow sensor operates reliably

min_ground_distance.note: (meters) Minimum distance from ground at which the optical flow sensor operates reliably

quality.note: Average of quality of accumulated frames, 0: bad quality, 255: maximum quality

avoidance_system_required.note: Set to true if avoidance system is enabled via COM_OBS_AVOID parameter

avoidance_system_valid.note: Status of the obstacle avoidance system

can_set_nav_states_mask.note: Bitmask for all modes that a user can select

component_id.note: subsystem / component id, contains MAVLink's component ID field

failsafe.note: true if system is in failsafe state (e.g.:RTL, Hover, Terminate, ...)

failsafe_and_user_took_over.note: true if system is in failsafe state but the user took over control

gcs_connection_lost_counter.note: counts unique GCS connection lost events

high_latency_data_link_lost.note: Set to true if the high latency data link (eg. RockBlock Iridium 9603 telemetry module) is lost

in_transition_mode.note: True if VTOL is doing a transition

in_transition_to_fw.note: True if VTOL is doing a transition from MC to FW

is_vtol.note: True if the system is VTOL capable

is_vtol_tailsitter.note: True if the system performs a 90° pitch down rotation during transition from MC to FW

nav_state_user_intention.note: Mode that the user selected (might be different from nav_state in a failsafe situation)

power_input_valid.note: set if input power is valid

pre_flight_checks_pass.note: true if all checks necessary to arm pass

safety_button_available.note: Set to true if a safety button is connected

safety_off.note: Set to true if safety is off

system_id.note: system id, contains MAVLink's system ID field

usb_connected.note: set to true (never cleared) once telemetry received from usb link

valid_nav_states_mask.note: Bitmask for all valid nav_state values

fixed_wing_system_failure.note: vehicle in fixed-wing system failure failsafe mode (after quad-chute)

vehicle_vtol_state.note: current state of the vtol, see VEHICLE_VTOL_STATE

variance_east.note: Wind estimate error variance in east / Y direction (m/sec)**2 - set to zero (no uncertainty) if not estimated

variance_north.note: Wind estimate error variance in north / X direction (m/sec)**2 - set to zero (no uncertainty) if not estimated

windspeed_east.note: Wind component in east / Y direction (m/sec)

windspeed_north.note: Wind component in north / X direction (m/sec)

parametersNote: 该 tag 无参数元数据：PX4 只在分支构建（main/master）发布 parameters.json，release tag 下没有；日志里的实际参数值来自 .ulg 的 initial_parameters。
